title: Browser Extensions & Privacy Add-ons Privacy Hardening Checklist
metaDescription: Complete checklist for securing your browser with privacy extensions, ad blockers, and security add-ons. Protect against tracking and ads.
intro: Browser extensions are powerful tools for enhancing your online privacy, but they require careful selection and configuration. This checklist guides you through choosing, installing, and optimizing privacy-focused extensions to protect against tracking, ads, and data collection.

items.why: Blocks ads, trackers, and malicious content while consuming minimal system resources compared to other ad blockers.
items.howTo: Download uBlock Origin from your browser's official extension store (Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons, etc.). Never install from third-party sites to avoid malicious versions.

items.why: Default settings may not block all tracking methods. Additional filter lists provide comprehensive protection against various threats.
items.howTo: Open uBlock Origin dashboard > Filter lists tab. Enable EasyPrivacy, Fanboy's Annoyances, and regional lists for your location. Update filters weekly.

items.task: Install Privacy Badger for tracker blocking
items.why: Uses algorithmic approach to detect and block trackers that adapt to traditional blockers, providing additional protection layer.
items.howTo: Install Privacy Badger from EFF's official extension page or browser store. It learns and improves blocking over time through your browsing patterns.

items.why: Protects against tracking through content delivery networks by serving common libraries locally instead of from external CDNs.
items.howTo: Install Decentraleyes from browser extension store. No configuration needed - it works automatically to intercept CDN requests.

items.why: Extensions with excessive permissions can access sensitive data, compromise privacy, or introduce security vulnerabilities.
items.howTo: Go to browser settings > Extensions. Review each extension's permissions. Remove extensions with unnecessary data access or from unknown developers.

items.task: Install HTTPS Everywhere or enable browser HTTPS-only mode
items.why: Ensures connections use encrypted HTTPS when available, preventing data interception and man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.howTo: For older browsers, install HTTPS Everywhere. For modern browsers, enable HTTPS-only mode in privacy settings instead.

items.task: Install ClearURLs to remove tracking parameters
items.why: Removes tracking parameters from URLs that bypass ad blockers and allow cross-site tracking through link sharing.
items.howTo: Install ClearURLs from browser extension store. Enable automatic URL cleaning and review blocked parameters in the extension popup.

items.why: Automatically deletes tracking cookies and website data to prevent long-term tracking and profile building.
items.howTo: Install Cookie AutoDelete or similar. Set to delete cookies when tabs close, but whitelist essential sites like email and banking.

items.task: Install User-Agent switcher for fingerprinting protection
items.why: Changes browser fingerprint by rotating user agent strings, making it harder for sites to track you across sessions.
items.howTo: Install User-Agent Switcher and Manager. Configure to rotate between common user agents automatically or manually switch when needed.

items.task: Install NoScript or uMatrix for script control
items.why: Blocks potentially malicious JavaScript and gives granular control over which scripts run on websites.
items.howTo: Install NoScript (Firefox) or uMatrix. Start with default-deny policy, then whitelist trusted domains. Requires learning curve but provides strong protection.

items.why: Prevents websites from using HTML5 canvas to create unique browser fingerprints for tracking purposes.
items.howTo: Install Canvas Blocker or enable fingerprinting protection in Privacy Badger settings. Some browsers have built-in canvas blocking in privacy settings.

items.task: Evaluate Incognito Browser for maximum privacy
items.why: Purpose-built privacy browser with pre-configured extensions and settings optimized for anonymity and data protection.
items.howTo: Download Incognito Browser as alternative for sensitive browsing. It includes built-in ad blocking, tracker protection, and privacy tools without manual configuration.

items.why: Outdated extensions may have security vulnerabilities or become ineffective against new tracking methods.
items.howTo: In browser settings > Extensions, enable automatic updates. Manually check for updates monthly and review changelog for privacy-related improvements.

items.why: Extensions can be sold to malicious actors or change privacy policies, compromising your protection over time.
items.howTo: Monthly review: Check extension developers, read recent reviews, verify permissions haven't changed, and remove unused or suspicious extensions.

items.task: Test ad and tracker blocking effectiveness
items.why: Ensures your privacy tools are working correctly and identifies any gaps in protection that need addressing.
items.howTo: Use sites like browserleaks.com, panopticlick.eff.org, and amiunique.org to test fingerprinting and tracking protection monthly.

items.why: Prevents loss of carefully configured privacy settings if you need to reinstall browser or extensions.
items.howTo: Export settings from uBlock Origin dashboard and other configurable extensions. Store backup files securely and update after major configuration changes.
